mapper.sql: version_id, item_key, content_hash, card_kind, card_id, event_id, symbol, signal_id, recommendation_id, decision_type, raw_choice, adopt_mode, quantity, skip_reason, structure, expiry_date, category, item_state, floating_pnl, settled_day, marked_time, marked_time_utc, sort_no, first_sync_id, last_sync_id, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc, update_by, update_time, update_time_utc, remark

select sync_id, feed_sync_id, feed_result, decision_result, choice_result, market_day, source_hash, result, signal_count, midterm_count, buyer_count, manage_count, new_version_count, changed_kinds, cost_ms, message, trigger_type, sync_time, sync_time_utc, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc from option_follow_sync
mapper.insert: insert into ${tableName} (item_key, content_hash, card_kind, card_id, event_id, symbol, signal_id, recommendation_id, decision_type, raw_choice, adopt_mode, quantity, skip_reason, structure, expiry_date, category, item_state, floating_pnl, settled_day, marked_time, marked_time_utc, sort_no, payload, first_sync_id, last_sync_id, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc, update_by, update_time, update_time_utc, remark) values (#{item.itemKey}, #{item.contentHash}, #{item.cardKind}, #{item.cardId}, #{item.eventId}, #{item.symbol}, #{item.signalId}, #{item.recommendationId}, #{item.decisionType}, #{item.rawChoice}, #{item.adoptMode}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.skipReason}, #{item.structure}, #{item.expiryDate}, #{item.category}, #{item.itemState}, #{item.floatingPnl}, #{item.settledDay}, #{item.markedTime}, date_sub(#{item.markedTime}, interval 8 hour), #{item.sortNo}, #{item.payload}, #{item.firstSyncId}, #{item.lastSyncId}, #{item.createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{item.createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{item.remark})

insert into option_follow_sync (feed_sync_id, feed_result, decision_result, choice_result, market_day, source_hash, result, message, trigger_type, sync_time, sync_time_utc, create_by, create_time, create_time_utc) values (#{feedSyncId}, #{feedResult}, #{decisionResult}, #{choiceResult}, #{marketDay}, #{sourceHash}, #{result}, #{message}, #{triggerType}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp(), #{createBy}, date_add(utc_timestamp(), interval 8 hour), utc_timestamp())
mapper.select: where result = 'UPDATED' order by sync_id desc limit 1
